name: Mean Reverse
summary: This EA implements a mean reversion strategy that trades against extreme price deviations, expecting price to return to its statistical mean. It identifies overbought and oversold conditions using deviation-based indicators and enters counter-trend positions when price stretches too far from its average. Exits are triggered when price reverts back toward the mean or when stop loss levels are hit.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了均值回归策略，在价格偏离均值过远时反向交易，预期价格将回归统计均值。它利用偏离类指标识别超买超卖状态，在价格过度偏离均值时入场反向操作。当价格回归均值或触及止损位时平仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是均值回归，即假设价格在偏离均值后终将回归。入场条件基于价格相对于均值（通常为移动平均线）的偏离程度，当偏离超过设定的阈值时，认为市场过度延伸而反向入场。做多条件为价格大幅低于均值达到超卖阈值，做空条件为价格大幅高于均值达到超买阈值。出场条件包括价格回归至均值附近时获利了结，以及预设的止损位触发止损。仓位管理通常采用固定手数或基于资金比例的动态手数方式。资金管理方面依赖止损来控制单笔风险，但均值回归策略在趋势行情中可能连续止损，需要合理的仓位控制来避免资金大幅回撤。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept is mean reversion, assuming that price will eventually return to its mean after significant deviation. Entry conditions are based on the degree of price deviation from a mean (typically a moving average), entering counter-trend when deviation exceeds a configured threshold. Long entries occur when price falls significantly below the mean reaching an oversold threshold, while short entries occur when price rises significantly above the mean reaching an overbought threshold. Exit conditions include taking profit when price reverts back near the mean, and stop loss triggers when the adverse move continues beyond the stop level. Position sizing typically uses fixed lots or equity-proportional sizing. Money management relies on stop losses to control per-trade risk, but mean reversion strategies can suffer consecutive losses during trending markets, requiring prudent position control to avoid significant drawdowns.
pros: 均值回归策略逻辑清晰，具有统计学理论基础
在震荡行情中表现良好，能够捕捉价格回归的交易机会
具有明确的止损机制，单笔风险可控
pros_en: Clear mean reversion logic grounded in statistical theory
Performs well in range-bound markets by capturing price reversion opportunities
Defined stop loss mechanism provides controlled per-trade risk
cons: 在强趋势行情中可能连续止损，造成较大回撤
均值回归策略天然逆势交易，可能承受较大的浮亏
缺乏趋势过滤机制，容易在趋势初期错误入场
cons_en: Can suffer consecutive stop losses during strong trending markets, leading to significant drawdowns
Mean reversion inherently trades against the trend, potentially enduring large floating losses
Lacks a trend filter mechanism, prone to premature entries at the beginning of new trends
improvements: 增加趋势过滤机制，在强趋势行情中暂停或减少均值回归交易
引入动态偏离阈值，根据市场波动率自适应调整入场条件
improvements_en: Add a trend filter to pause or reduce mean reversion trades during strong trending conditions
Introduce dynamic deviation thresholds that adapt entry conditions based on market volatility

risk_points: 逆势交易在趋势行情中可能产生连续亏损
缺乏多时间框架确认可能导致在错误周期入场
risk_points_en: Counter-trend trading can produce consecutive losses during trending markets
Lack of multi-timeframe confirmation may lead to entries at the wrong market phase

It identifies overbought and oversold conditions using deviation-based indicators and enters counter-trend positions when price stretches too far from its average. Exits are triggered when price reverts back toward the mean or when stop loss levels are hit.
